title: BitMart Earn Fixed Savings Introduction
notes: First-party introduction to the BitMart Earn hub and fixed Savings products. It is used as the earliest reviewed product-specific date, not proof of the launch date for every Earn feature.

title: BitMart Savings product page
notes: Describes flexible and fixed Savings, interest calculation, transfers from Spot Wallet to Earn account, and redemption back to Spot Wallet. Marketing language is not treated as a guarantee of principal or return.

title: BitMart Staking product page
notes: Describes transfers from Spot Wallet to Earn Wallet and states that assets may be used for on-chain staking or other supported earning activities.

title: BitMart User Agreement
notes: The Savings provisions state that subscribed assets may be used for operating purposes, including loans to clients or affiliates, and distinguish flexible from fixed redemption conditions.

title: Terms and Conditions for BitMart Crypto Loans
notes: Describes collateral control, repayment obligations, emergency suspension rights, and optional Flexible Savings yield on frozen collateral.

title: Important Notice Regarding the Orderly Cessation of BitMart Operations
notes: Primary source for the orderly wind-down announcement and phased discontinuation of Earn, Staking, Lending, and other products.

title: BitMart wind-down restrictions beginning 26 July 2026
notes: Primary source for the gradual suspension of registration, deposits, new orders, new positions, and automated trading services while withdrawals remained available subject to review.

title: BitMart trading cessation schedule for 26 August 2026
notes: Primary source for the scheduled future trading cessation. The evidence records an announced deadline, not completed cessation as of the review date.

title: BitMart formal platform termination schedule for 31 January 2027
notes: Primary source for the scheduled future platform termination and planned limited post-termination account and withdrawal access.
